bk.title: Cloud backup (encrypted)
bk.intro: Back up your ledger, paper journal, settings, pre-registrations and scoring profile to your own cloud storage. The file is encrypted on this device with your passphrase before it is uploaded. Market history stays on the device.
bk.passphraseRule: At least 12 characters. It is never stored or uploaded. If you forget it, the backup cannot be opened.
bk.state.needsGateway: Add a bucket key with ব্যক্তিগত API (the key button in the header) while the local gateway runs on this computer
bk.state.notHere: Not set up for this web address
bk.skipped: Left out because a restore could not read them: {rows} ledger rows, {prereg} pre-registrations, {trials} trials, {journal} paper trades.
bk.failed: That did not work on this device. Try again.
bk.restore.counts: Ledger: {rows} rows, {added} new. Paper journal: {journal} trades, {jadded} new. Pre-registrations: {prereg}, {padded} new.
bk.restore.rejected: {n} items could not be read and will not be restored.
bk.restore.tooOld: {n} rows are older than this device keeps ({days} days) and will not be restored.
bk.restore.overCap: This device keeps at most {max} rows; {n} rows from the oldest days (on this device or in the backup) will be removed to stay within it.
bk.restore.agePruned: {n} days of rows older than {days} days will be removed from this device, as usual.
bk.restore.newerRecords: This device has records newer than the backup; they are kept.
bk.restore.settings: Also restore settings and the scoring profile
bk.restore.newer: Your settings were changed after this backup ({time}). Restoring them replaces your newer settings.
bk.restore.differs: The backup's settings or scoring profile differ from this device's. Restoring them replaces the ones here.
bk.err.decrypt: This backup could not be opened: the passphrase is wrong or the file was changed.
bk.err.passphrase: Use the same passphrase twice, at least 12 characters.
bk.err.too-large-backup: The backup would be {size}; the limit is 20 MB. Export the ledger as CSV from the Ledger instead.
bk.err.too-large-file: The file is larger than 20 MB and was not opened.
bk.err.format: This is not a Confluence Terminal backup, or it was made by a newer version.
bk.err.schema: This is not a Confluence Terminal backup, or it was made by a newer version.
bk.err.unsupported: This device cannot open compressed backups. Restore it in the desktop app or a current browser.
bk.err.not-set-up: This provider is not available here.
bk.err.unavailable: This provider is not available here.
bk.err.sign-in: Sign-in did not finish. Try again.
bk.err.state: Sign-in was refused because its check value did not match. Try again.
bk.err.session: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
bk.err.network: The provider could not be reached.
bk.err.download-host: Restoring from OneDrive needs its download server ({origin}), which this build does not allow yet.
bk.err.port-busy: Sign-in needs port 48787 on this computer, which another program is using.
bk.err.gateway: The local gateway did not accept the request. Reconnect with ব্যক্তিগত API (the key button in the header).
bk.err.needs-gateway: Add a bucket key with ব্যক্তিগত API (the key button in the header) first.
bk.err.foreign: This sign-in was meant for the phone app or has expired. Start it again from Cloud backup.
bk.err.partial: Restore stopped part-way: {n} items were written. Running the same restore again is safe.
bk.uploadAuditFailed: The backup was uploaded, but its audit entry could not be written.
bk.skippedReplay: {n} replay ledger rows are not backed up (only live rows are).
bk.restore.records: Measured outcomes: {outcomes} rows, {oadded} new. Universe snapshots: {universes}, {uadded} new. Recorded gaps: {gaps}, {gadded} new. Trade notes: {notes}, {nadded} new.
bk.restore.notKept: {n} outcome records, universe snapshots or gaps will not be kept: their rows are not on this device or are older than it keeps, or there is no room for them. No row is removed to make room.
bk.skippedRecords: {n} other records (measured outcomes, universe snapshots, gaps or trade notes) were left out because a restore could not read them.
